messages:
maria: @channel Heads-up: scheduled maintenance for the inference control plane on Tue 2026-04-07 01:00-02:00 UTC (US-W, EU-W). This is a TLS cert rotation + rolling service restart across control-plane components. Expected customer-facing impact: minimal; possible short 30-90s API latency spikes for some Dedicated pools during their node restart. Hosted API will auto-failover; no auth key changes needed. Draft statuspage and customer notification below. Please read and ack if you'll be oncall for the window.

alex: ack. I can be primary oncall for the window. I'll coordinate the rolling sequence with infra and runtime.

devon: noted. I'll be standby for paging (pager duty) and will handle any Dedicated capacity escalation. FYI — added the maintenance tag to the oncall calendar.

ops-bot: Maintenance scheduled: id=maint-20260407-ctlp-01, start=2026-04-07T01:00:00Z, end=2026-04-07T02:00:00Z, regions=[us-west-2, eu-west-1]. Organizer=maria. Reminders set at 60m and 10m.

maria: copy. Posting proposed statuspage update here for review (please don't post until 2h before window):
```
Summary: We will perform a scheduled maintenance to rotate control-plane TLS certificates and apply a rolling restart to control-plane services in select regions. Some Dedicated customers in affected regions may experience brief latency spikes or request queuing while their reserved pools restart. Hosted API and Private customers with local control planes are expected to be unaffected.

When: 2026-04-07 01:00 - 02:00 UTC
Impact: Short (30-90s) latency spikes for a subset of Dedicated requests per region during the rolling restart. No schema or contract changes.
Mitigation: automatic failover to secondary control-plane nodes; canary restarts, throttling controls enabled; SRE will monitor token-level latency.
Contact: support@redwood.ai and status.redwood.ai
```

jamie: tiny wording suggestion for customer email: add the line "No action required on your side; we will notify you if we detect any sustained degradation." Also mention timezone conversions for customers in APAC.

maria: good call. Updated copy: "No action required on your side; if we detect sustained degradation (>5m), we'll open a ticket and reach out directly."

alex: runbook link for oncall: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/control-plane-rotation. Quick checklist: 1) confirm maintenance id in ops-bot 2) watch the control-plane health dashboard (console -> infra -> control-plane) 3) if Dedicated pools exceed 5% error-rate or >2min queuing, trigger fallback plan (roll back cert and pause restarts).

sre-rotation: I'm scheduled to handoff to alex at 2026-04-07 00:45 UTC. I'll post a short handoff note in #eng-oncall 15m before window with contact details.

maria: added a brief customer-facing SMS snippet for high-touch customers: "Redwood: Scheduled maint 2026-04-07 01:00-02:00 UTC. Brief possible latency spikes for reserved capacity in US-W/EU-W. No action needed. — Redwood Support"

devon: paging rules: keep paging threshold low for first 20m (page on any sustained 5xx or >40% latency increase over baseline). After the rolling restart completes, relax thresholds. I'll coordinate with alex on escalation routing.

maria: ops checklist to run 10m before start:
- post statuspage scheduled maintenance (statuspage-bot will post)
- send customer email to Dedicated customers in affected regions (jamie)
- confirm oncall contact (alex)
- enable extended tracing for first 30m

statuspage-bot: Scheduled maintenance created on status.redwood.ai: Maint #3247 — Control-plane TLS rotation & rolling restart — 2026-04-07 01:00-02:00 UTC — Regions: us-west-2, eu-west-1. (preview link: https://status.redwood.ai/preview/3247)

jamie: email draft ready, sending at T-minus 2h. I'll copy support and account leads for top 20 customers.

maria: thanks. Quick note: if anyone needs to change the window, we prefer to make the change >24h out. If we need to shorten by 15-30m during execution, coordinate via this thread and tag @devon and @alex.

--- (later, during maintenance) ---

ops-bot: Maintenance maint-20260407-ctlp-01: phase=region-us-west-2; action=restart-begin; time=2026-04-07T01:10:00Z

alex: Starting restart in us-west-2 baseline cluster. Monitoring latencies.

devon: seeing a ~60s tail latency spike on a small subset of Dedicated pools (pools: d-res-45,d-res-12). No errors yet, queue length up to 1-2 per 100 reqs. Holding the next region for now while we watch.

alex: acknowledged. Holding eu-west-1 until us-west-2 stabilizes. Enabling additional tracing for those pools.

maria: posting interim statuspage note: "Interim: performing rolling restart in us-west-2. Brief latency spikes observed for some reserved pools; mitigation active. No sustained degradation."

statuspage-bot: Incident update posted: https://status.redwood.ai/3247#update1

jamie: I've proactively messaged top 10 accounts in us-west-2; none have reported issues so far.

ops-bot: Maintenance maint-20260407-ctlp-01: phase=region-us-west-2; action=restart-complete; time=2026-04-07T01:25:10Z; region-status=stable

alex: us-west-2 complete, no rollback required. Proceeding to eu-west-1 in 5m.

devon: thanks. Paging thresholds restored to normal after eu-west-1 completes.

ops-bot: Maintenance maint-20260407-ctlp-01: phase=region-eu-west-1; action=restart-begin; time=2026-04-07T01:35:00Z

alex: eu-west-1 restart in progress. Watching metrics.

devon: slight queueing observed for a very small tenant group, cleared within 45s. No paging.

ops-bot: Maintenance maint-20260407-ctlp-01: phase=region-eu-west-1; action=restart-complete; time=2026-04-07T01:47:30Z; region-status=stable

maria: Maintenance completed. Final statuspage update: "Completed: Control-plane TLS rotation & rolling restart completed across scheduled regions. Some reserved capacity experienced brief latency spikes; no sustained customer impact detected. If you see anything, please reopen a ticket or @channel in #incidents."

statuspage-bot: Maintenance maint-20260407-ctlp-01 marked completed on status.redwood.ai: https://status.redwood.ai/3247#completed

jamie: customer email follow-up queued: "Maintenance completed. If you experienced issues, reply and we'll open a ticket." Sending now to affected lists.

sre-rotation: Handed back to next rotation. alex, leaving you with runbook notes in #eng-oncall.

alex: thanks all. Postmortem template: low severity; tracking perf histograms and customer logs. I'll file a short blameless note and attach graphs. Closing thread once postmortem draft is in the tracker.

maria: great job everyone. Closing announcement thread. If anyone needs the raw traces, ping me and I'll share a secure link. :party_parrot:
